entities.summary: "Twisting by the Pool" is a song by British rock band Dire Straits that appears on ExtendedancEPlay. It was released as a single in 1983, peaking at No. 1 in New Zealand, No. 14 on the UK Singles Chart and at No. 12 on the US Billboard Rock Top Tracks chart. A remix of the song appeared on the band's 1988 greatest hits album Money for Nothing.
